messages:
Anika R: Quick q - we're comparing two vendors for embedding store: IndexFlow vs VectorKeep. pricing model differences are confusing: per-request vs per-GB stored. leaning toward VectorKeep but need ops input. @Devon C

Devon C: IndexFlow charges $0.0008 per vector query + $0.15 / GB-month. VectorKeep charges $0.10 /GB-month but bundles 500k queries in the base tier then $0.0005 per extra. For our production traffic (est 6M queries / mo) cost math favors VectorKeep if we can fit in bundle. but retrieval latency on IndexFlow was lower in p95.

Leah M: ops note: IndexFlow has better prefetch caching and can run on dedicated instances, which reduces p95 for our 2k qps bursts. VectorKeep's burst behavior throttles at tier boundary unless we buy burst addon.

Anika R: procurement wants TCO for 12 months incl. storage growth. can someone make a quick calc w/ 20% monthly growth and two scenarios: (a) optimize for cost, (b) optimize for latency SLA? we need numbers by EOD for leadership sync.

Devon C: I'll spin up a spreadsheet but quick back-of-envelope: starting storage 5TB. scenario A (cost-first): VectorKeep bundle covers 500k queries -> we'd need 11 extra bundles at our growth -> but still cheaper overall. Scenario B (latency-first): IndexFlow dedicated instances add $7k/month but keep p95 < 120ms.

procurement-bot: creating procurement comparison doc at https://confluence.redwood/procure/embedding-indexflow-vs-vectorkeep-184555

Leah M: suggest we negotiate a hybrid: VectorKeep for cold storage + IndexFlow for hot tier. ask both vendors for hot-tier pricing (per-shard) and for ingress/egress rules. often vendors will propose a multi-tier discount.

Anika R: good idea. @Devon C can you add hybrid run-rate and ask vendors for a pilot discount + trial extension? procurement will use that leverage in negotiation.

Devon C: will do. emailing both now requesting pilot extension + clarification on bundled query rollover and hotspot pricing. response ETA 48h.

Leah M: cc finance ops so they can model amortized commit discounts. we should also check contract minimums and termination windows.

Anika R: thanks team. capturing action items in the confluence doc. leadership sync at 3pm will take recommendation. :white_check_mark:
